customer_message.subject: Help contesting lease termination - Kirchgasse 11, Zug
customer_message.body: hi, i need some help with my flat. i live at Kirchgasse 11 in Zug, its a 3.5 room flat, and my husband Alex lives here with me too, its our family home. the landlord Wincasa Nord AG is ending our lease and i think its retaliation. about two months ago i complained in writing about mould in the bathroom and the heating not working properly, and i also challenged the rent increase they wanted. since then the tone changed completely. i believe they are punishing me for asserting my rights. it feels like they want us out because we pushed back, and i really want to fight it properly rather than just accept it. i want to contest this and i dont know where to start. can you tell me what my options are and whether you cover a lawyer for this? i can send you my correspondence with the landlord. thanks, Sam
